evidenceClaims.statement: A concordant hyperfunctioning nodule usually does not require FNA.

evidenceClaims.statement: Solid hypoechogenicity with irregular margins or punctate calcifications supports an ATA high-suspicion pattern.

evidenceClaims.statement: Observation can be reasonable for an asymptomatic spongiform nodule.

evidenceClaims.statement: Biopsy targeting follows each nodule?s risk pattern and size, rather than the largest diameter alone.

evidenceClaims.sourceLocator: ETA 2023 Table 1 thyroid biopsy: repeat FNA excludes a solitary cyst.

evidenceClaims.statement: A thyroid lesion with entirely cystic sonography and no solid component does not require diagnostic FNA solely for malignancy assessment.
evidenceClaims.limitation: Symptomatic recurrent cyst treatment is a different indication.
evidenceClaims.applicablePopulation: Adults with the specific thyroid presentation and acquired findings supplied in the reviewed correction candidate.
evidenceClaims.sourceLocator: ATA nodule recommendation 8 benign pattern; ETA EU-TIRADS 2.

evidenceClaims.statement: After two benign thyroid FNA results, routine repeat biopsy for malignancy is generally unnecessary.
evidenceClaims.limitation: Confirm target concordance; symptoms and other unresolved clinical concerns still require separate evaluation.
evidenceClaims.applicablePopulation: Adults with the specific thyroid presentation and acquired findings supplied in the reviewed correction candidate.
evidenceClaims.sourceLocator: ATA nodule recommendation 23D; ETA 2023 repeat-biopsy statements.

evidenceClaims.statement: For suspected invasive DTC, intravenous contrast improves cross-sectional delineation of relationships to adjacent structures.
evidenceClaims.limitation: One current guideline; no claim that all cancers need CT or that MRI is inferior.
evidenceClaims.applicablePopulation: Adults with the specific thyroid presentation and acquired findings supplied in the reviewed correction candidate.

evidenceClaims.statement: In most patients, the anatomic benefit of indicated preoperative contrast imaging outweighs concern about later radioiodine timing.
evidenceClaims.limitation: One guideline. No fixed iodine-clearance or radioiodine wait interval is authored.
evidenceClaims.applicablePopulation: Adults with the specific thyroid presentation and acquired findings supplied in the reviewed correction candidate.

evidenceClaims.statement: Rising Tg or Tg antibodies after total thyroidectomy with no explanatory cervical ultrasound finding warrants additional cross-sectional assessment of common distant sites.
evidenceClaims.limitation: One current guideline; antibodies do not themselves establish metastasis or mandate empiric treatment.
evidenceClaims.applicablePopulation: Adults with the specific thyroid presentation and acquired findings supplied in the reviewed correction candidate.

evidenceClaims.statement: When feasible, compartmental dissection is preferred to isolated node picking for clinically significant resectable recurrent DTC nodal disease.
evidenceClaims.limitation: Reoperative planes, previous dissection and involved structures require individual planning; no numerical surgery threshold invented.
evidenceClaims.applicablePopulation: Adults with the specific thyroid presentation and acquired findings supplied in the reviewed correction candidate.
evidenceClaims.sourceLocator: ATA 2025 recurrent nodal surgery discussion and recommendation 20.

evidenceClaims.statement: After unilateral surgery for presumed sporadic MTC, RET germline mutation, elevated postoperative calcitonin or residual disease on imaging supports completion thyroidectomy.
evidenceClaims.limitation: ATA recommendation 28; limited evidence and individual risk/benefit assessment apply.
evidenceClaims.applicablePopulation: Adults with the specific thyroid presentation and acquired findings supplied in the reviewed correction candidate.
evidenceClaims.sourceLocator: ATA MTC recommendation 28 and post-hemithyroidectomy discussion.

evidenceClaims.statement: Further thyroid resection is not automatically indicated after unilateral surgery when hereditary testing is negative, postoperative calcitonin is not elevated and imaging shows no residual MTC.
evidenceClaims.limitation: Single guideline with explicitly limited data; named clinician must review this constructed surveillance-versus-completion decision.
evidenceClaims.applicablePopulation: Adults with the specific thyroid presentation and acquired findings supplied in the reviewed correction candidate.
evidenceClaims.sourceLocator: ATA MTC recommendation 28 and preceding discussion.

evidenceClaims.statement: An examination ending above the true vocal folds does not establish their mobility.
evidenceClaims.limitation: Anatomic evidence-scope application of the requirement to assess vocal-fold mobility; no test sensitivity asserted.
evidenceClaims.applicablePopulation: Adults with the specific thyroid presentation and acquired findings supplied in the reviewed correction candidate.

evidenceClaims.statement: Selected calcitonin needle washout can supplement inconclusive cytology suggesting MTC; a serum concentration is not a specimen-specific sample.
evidenceClaims.limitation: No washout cutoff or diagnostic certainty from marker detectability is asserted.
evidenceClaims.applicablePopulation: Adults with the specific thyroid presentation and acquired findings supplied in the reviewed correction candidate.
evidenceClaims.sourceLocator: ATA MTC recommendation 19; ETA suspicious-node/nodule washout guidance.

rightsPolicy: Store bibliography, links and original atomic claims only. No source prose, full text, figures, algorithms, tables or excerpts stored. Availability in PMC is not a license.

excludedSources.source: UpToDate, commercial banks, proprietary textbooks, SCORE and recalled examination questions
excludedSources.reason: Excluded by repository policy; no source opened or used. Search engines incidentally returned excluded results; those snippets were not used.

excludedSources.source: SAGE/Liebert publisher full text and 2026 ATA pregnancy guideline DOI 10.1177/10507256261445624
excludedSources.reason: No publisher full text ingested. Official ATA guideline index verified the update exists; UC eScholarship full-page access showed a robot check. Do not use inaccessible search snippets as evidence or claim a complete current pregnancy review.
PMC displayed a browser check and publisher endpoint returned 403. No detailed facts derived from snippets; ATA operative-anatomy recommendations supply the authored claims.
Browser check prevented primary article access; used society-hosted supporting guidance actually read instead.

withheldDisagreements.question: Automatic PTU-to-methimazole switching after early pregnancy
withheldDisagreements.reason: A 2026 ATA pregnancy update exists; full recommendation text was inaccessible through consulted permitted routes. No exact later-pregnancy switch rule authored.

withheldDisagreements.question: Prophylactic lateral dissection in ultrasound-negative MTC
withheldDisagreements.reason: ATA MTC recommendation 25 explicitly lacked task-force consensus; no universal calcitonin cutoff or mandatory lateral surgery keyed.

withheldDisagreements.question: A universal thyroid-nodule size threshold across ATA, EU-TIRADS and BTA U systems
withheldDisagreements.reason: These systems use different patterns and thresholds. Draft thresholds are ATA-specific; do not mix frameworks or average cutoffs.
